recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. Any future changes to this language-communication extension should be made in HL7/fhir-extensions; no follow-up core source edit is needed for FHIR-46016.
issue_request: FHIR-46016 was Applied and resolved Persuasive with Modification. It requested a way to indicate the languages an Organization or OrganizationAffiliation can use to conduct business, with the approved approach of widening the existing location-communication extension and allowing it to repeat.
initial_application: The location-communication extension was originally a core standard extension for Location, but core commit dd468d4f17 removed standard extension definitions from the R5 core source. HL7/fhir-extensions commit 329b91da5d9586173eec0f68430f3a68e40cb42d then applied FHIR-46016 by adding Organization and OrganizationAffiliation contexts to input/definitions/Location/StructureDefinition-location-communication.xml and changing Extension.max from 1 to *.
additional_context: The current Extension Pack source still contains Location, Organization, and OrganizationAffiliation contexts with max='*'. Later Extension Pack QA commits retained those contexts while adding metadata and version-specific-use annotations. Core source/fhir.ini lists Organization, OrganizationAffiliation, and Location resources, but the core checkout contains only the extension OID mapping, not the authoritative StructureDefinition source.
reconciliation: Published an empty external-repo audit commit on the combined core branch. No core source change was made because the relevant editable StructureDefinition source belongs to HL7/fhir-extensions and already satisfies the Jira decision.

related_jiras.note: FHIR-46017 reused the FHIR-46016 extension for ExtendedContactDetail and was applied in the same Extension Pack commit.

evidence_items.summary: Applied/Persuasive with Modification request to support languages for Organization and OrganizationAffiliation by widening the location-communication extension and allowing repeats.
evidence_items.learned: This establishes the final approved target for the seed issue.

evidence_items.summary: The current Extension Pack source includes Location, Organization, and OrganizationAffiliation contexts and Extension.max='*'.
evidence_items.learned: The requested Organization and OrganizationAffiliation applicability and repeatability are present in the external source of truth.

evidence_items.summary: Applied FHIR-46016 and FHIR-46017 by adding Organization, OrganizationAffiliation, and ExtendedContactDetail contexts and changing max from 1 to *.
evidence_items.learned: The issue was implemented in the Extension Pack rather than the core checkout.

evidence_items.summary: Removed standard extension definitions, including location-communication, from the R5 core source.
evidence_items.learned: The current core checkout intentionally does not own the extension StructureDefinition source.

evidence_items.summary: PA minutes reference FHIR-46016 discussion around OrganizationAffiliation and later note FHIR-46017 as a follow-on to the FHIR-46016 extension work.
evidence_items.learned: The work-group record supports treating FHIR-46016 and FHIR-46017 as one extension-family application.

evidence_items.summary: Brian Postlethwaite asked whether changing the extension from 0..1 to 0..* for FHIR-46016/FHIR-46017 was breaking; Grahame Grieve and John Moehrke treated it as not breaking in the same sense as a property.
evidence_items.learned: This corroborates the Jira application comment that widening the existing extension was acceptable.

evidence_items.locator: Core and Extension Pack source-scope checks
evidence_items.summary: Core contains only the OID mapping for the extension, while Extension Pack input/extensions-ig.xml includes input/definitions/* and the extension source is under that tree.
evidence_items.learned: The remaining editable StructureDefinition source is outside the current core checkout.
